comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. OpenStreetMap has no landuse=winter_sports polygon for Paoli Peaks (checked 2026-11-14: only a leisure=sports_centre node, node/1671352941, named Paoli Peaks), so its ski area is derived from its own lifts and runs ("ski_area": "derived", the 100 m buffer, as Mountain High's): the wooded hill west of Paoli, an upside-down hill with the Main Lodge on top, its runs falling north-east from the lodge to the lifts' bottoms by the creek, on one ticket and one map (Epic). No other ski area lies in the box or the Overpass window, and no part of the resort is reached only by shuttle or road. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-14 against Paoli Peaks' Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251114_PK_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map paolipeaks.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links as the Paoli Peaks Winter 2025-2026 Trail Map), the newest the resort publishes; the site serves curl an error page, so the page was read with WebFetch and the PDF fetched with WebFetch (two 792 x 612 pt pages, the same painting on both, an image with no text layer), rendered at two and four times its size and read tile by tile. Its key: Beginner (green circle), Intermediate (blue square), Expert (one black diamond, the map's top grade), Freestyle Terrain (an orange pill with its feature size), Slow Zone and Beginner Zone; read as OSM's easy (and novice), intermediate and advanced, the one diamond drawn as the app's black (advanced), as Alta's and Diamond Peak's scales that top at a single black. Its lifts are the QUAD, TRIPLE and CTEC-I (a triple) chairs, the DOUBLE by the lodge, the Discovery Zone's carpet and the tubing park's carpet (Arctic Blast); the resort's mountain-info page counts 8 lifts, 15 trails and 1 terrain park (its lift and terrain status loads by script, so the printed map is the only source and wins). Of the map's 15 trails, 14 are in OSM, every rated one with the map's rating (Graber's Express and Bobcat, the two diamonds, advanced in OSM). Parks: Pioneer Park, drawn orange with an M-L (medium and large features) pill, gets the park flag, keeping OSM's rating (intermediate). Names from the map: CTEC-I (OSM CTEC I); Quad, Triple and Double as OSM has them. Kept as OSM has them, unnamed: the Discovery Zone's carpet (95 m, along the zone's edge beside the Quad's top) and a 24 m carpet at the zone's top by the lodge, which the map does not draw (the resort counts 8 lifts, two more than the map draws, so it is not hidden). OSM gaps: Bunny Meadows (a beginner run between the Quad's top and the Triple's) and the tubing park's carpet are not in OSM.

overrides.reason: CTEC I: the triple chair on the right of the map, from the bottom by the creek up to the lodge, which Paoli Peaks' Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251114_PK_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map paolipeaks.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links as the Paoli Peaks Winter 2025-2026 Trail Map) labels CTEC-I with a triple-chair sign. Name from the map.

Pioneer Park: the freestyle line between Mindbender and the CTEC-I, which Paoli Peaks' Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251114_PK_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the map paolipeaks.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links as the Paoli Peaks Winter 2025-2026 Trail Map) labels PIONEER PARK in orange with the Freestyle Terrain pill marked M-L (medium and large features) and no rating symbol; the resort's mountain-info page counts one terrain park. OSM has no park tag. Park flag from the map; OSM's rating (intermediate) stays.
